suite: Module 33 — Customer Web + Platform Admin on the real local backend with the DEVELOPMENT push provider (fake), the local mailer, SMS off, Laravel Reverb and the DEVELOPMENT payment provider (PAYMENT_DRIVER=fake) — no money moves; Razorpay itself is NOT exercised

results.name: A1 DEVICE REGISTRATION (PUT /customer/devices/current): the first call creates (201), the same installation again with a refreshed token updates the same row (200, same id); a second installation is a second device; the answer never carries the token
A2 MY DEVICES (GET /customer/devices): two active rows, the calling installation marked current, token state ACTIVE, no token anywhere
A3 A CUSTOMER ID IN THE REGISTRATION IS REFUSED (422 validation_failed): the device belongs to the authenticated principal, never to a field
A4 A PAID ORDER EXISTS (Module 31 / 32 path unchanged): the payment page waited for the server's order number and opened its confirmation

A5 THE ORDER CREATED THE IN-APP NOTIFICATION (GET /customer/notifications): type order.created, category ORDER_UPDATES, the restaurant's name and the order number in the body, action ORDER_DETAIL + the order number, unread; the unread count is part of the answer
results.detail: {"title":"Order placed","body":"Your order FOTG-20261011-326D9G has reached Burger Hub. We will tell you as soon as they confirm it.","action":{"target":"ORDER_DETAIL","reference":"FOTG-20261011-326D9G"},"unread":1}

results.name: A6 ONE PUSH PER DEVICE (admin GET /admin/notifications/{id}): the live device SENT through the development provider (a provider reference, one attempt), the dead device INVALID_DESTINATION (UNREGISTERED, one attempt, never retried); the in-app delivery SENT; the e-mail SKIPPED with SKIP_USER_PREFERENCE (order e-mail is the one channel this fixture customer switched off in Module 25; the no-address skip is covered by the backend tests) — and the logical notification stands
A7 THE DEAD TOKEN WAS REMOVED: the device the provider reported unregistered is revoked (INVALID_TOKEN) and gone from my active devices; the live one stays

A8 THE PUSH PAYLOAD (what the development provider received): notification + minimal data (type, notification_id, category, target, reference, subject_id, channel_id, created_at — all strings), android priority NORMAL, channel orders, visibility PRIVATE, a collapse key; no token, no phone, no e-mail, no amount, no item
B1 THE HEADER BELL (Customer Web) shows the real unread count from the backend
B2 THE NOTIFICATIONS PAGE lists the backend inbox (no development-data note): the newest item is the order notice, unread
B3 THE PREFERENCES PANEL names what each channel can do on this server: in-app available, push = development provider, e-mail pending, SMS not available
results.detail: In app available Push development provider on this machine (no real message leaves it) Email provider pending — nothing is sent yet SMS not available

results.name: B4 OPENING THE NOTICE marks it read on the backend (POST /customer/notifications/{id}/read) and follows its allow-listed target to the order page (/order/<number>) — never a URL from the data
B5 THE UNREAD COUNT FELL BY ONE and the read is idempotent (a second read keeps the first read_at)
C1 ACCEPT → order.accepted (ORDER_UPDATES, action ORDER_TRACKING) in the inbox within seconds; the live tracking page refreshed the inbox so the bell rose without a reload
C2 PREPARING → an in-app notice only (no push fatigue): the admin view shows IN_APP SENT and NO push delivery row at all (the registry says push off for this type)

C3 READY → order.ready is a PICKUP_UPDATES notice of HIGH priority on the pickup channel, action ORDER_TRACKING; the SMS channel is OFF on this server (SKIPPED, SKIP_CHANNEL_DISABLED — never a failure); the push went to the live device
C4 THE READY PUSH CARRIES NO SECRET: priority HIGH, channel pickup — and neither the QR payload nor the pickup code nor "FOTG1." is anywhere in it; the body sends the customer to the app for the code
results.detail: {"title":"Your order is ready","body":"Order FOTG-20261011-326D9G is ready for pickup at Burger Hub. Open the app to show your pickup code."}

results.name: C5 THE INBOX IS NEWEST FIRST and filters work: ?unread=1 lists only unread rows; ?category=PICKUP_UPDATES lists the ready notice only

D1 PUSH OFF FOR ORDER UPDATES (PATCH /customer/notification-preferences): the next order's notice is still written in-app, its push delivery is SKIPPED with SKIP_USER_PREFERENCE — nothing was sent, nothing failed
D2 THE PREFERENCE MATRIX (Module 25) now carries the channel status of this server: IN_APP AVAILABLE, PUSH DEVELOPMENT, EMAIL PENDING, SMS UNAVAILABLE
E1 ANOTHER CUSTOMER sees none of my notices (empty inbox), cannot mark mine read (404), cannot touch my device (404 / 404); no session → 401
E2 ADMIN RBAC: an administrator without admin.notifications.view (moderation) gets 403 on the list and on a resend; a restaurant token gets 401 / 403

F1 SIGN-OUT WITH THE INSTALLATION ID (POST /auth/logout {installation_id}) ends the push binding (LOGOUT) in the same request — the phone keeps its token, Firebase is not touched, nothing of Rahul's reaches it any more

F2 A SHARED PHONE: Asha signs in on the same installation → her binding is created; Rahul signs in on it again → Asha's row ends (REBOUND, a security event) and a new row is Rahul's; one active binding per installation at any time
F3 RAHUL'S NEXT NOTICE goes to Rahul's current binding only: exactly one push delivery, its device belongs to Rahul (never to Asha's ended binding)
G1 ADMIN › NOTIFICATIONS › DELIVERY STATUS (Platform Admin, Alex) lists the real notifications of this run from the backend with their delivery summary
G2 SEARCH BY ORDER NUMBER, then THE DETAIL DRAWER shows every delivery with its channel, status and policy result, the attempts, the dedupe key and the template version — and no token, no phone

results.name: G3 THE REGISTRY TAB shows the backend's mapping (11 types: order.created … account.phone_changed) with category, domain events, channel rules, priority, template version and locales; the API says the same
G4 ADMIN › SYSTEM › NOTIFICATION DELIVERY card: health from the backend, push driver fake with the plain statement REAL FCM = PENDING FIREBASE CONFIGURATION, the counters of this run
results.detail: OPERATIONAL | Development provider — no real push is sent; outcomes are simulated from the token. REAL FCM = PENDING FIREBASE CONFIGUR

results.name: G5 THE SYSTEM REPORT (GET /admin/system/notifications) tells the truth about the providers: push OPERATIONAL (development provider, says no real push is sent), e-mail = local mailer / REAL EMAIL PROVIDER = PENDING, SMS OFF; the queue has nothing stranded

G6 A CREDENTIAL FAILURE AT THE PROVIDER: the delivery is FAILED (AUTH_CONFIGURATION, UNAUTHENTICATED), never retried in a storm; the device stays active; the push provider is paused and the system report says DEGRADED with paused_after_auth_failure

G7 A CONTROLLED RESEND from the admin UI (Send again + a reason): POST …/retry → the delivery is RETRY_SCHEDULED (a new attempt on the same delivery; the history stays), audited with the actor and the reason; the button exists only for a FAILED delivery with a live destination
G8 A RESEND IS REFUSED for a delivery that is not FAILED (409 delivery_not_retryable) — the one just scheduled, and an in-app record
H1 A DELIVERY LEFT SENDING BY A CRASHED WORKER is found by notifications:recover after the lease (120 s) and queued again (RETRY_SCHEDULED, STRANDED)
H2 notifications:prune runs as a bounded job (nothing of this run is old enough to expire; order history is never touched)
H3 THE ORDERS NEVER NOTICED ANY OF THIS: order A is READY_FOR_PICKUP with the Module 32 timeline intact (4 lines), order B READY_FOR_PICKUP; no notification outcome changed an order
H4 THE BACKEND LOG OF THIS RUN carries no push token, no QR payload and no pickup code

I1 MEASURED on this machine (PHP built-in server, no OPcache; queue worker local): accept → the accepted notice readable in the inbox 1071 ms; inbox read 286 ms; admin detail 289 ms (measurements, not targets)
I2 THE SAVED API SAMPLES carry no push token, no QR payload and no pickup code
I3 no JavaScript error and no dialog in any page of the run
Z1 CLEAN-UP: every order, fulfilment record, payment attempt, checkout, reservation and cart of this run is removed; the FREEMEAL count is as it was
